changes: New: 🔁 Same Bet button added to Big Wheel, Blackjack, Baccarat, Casino War, Video Poker, Mines, and Plinko — restores your exact last bet in one tap (including Perfect Pairs / Pairs side bets where relevant, bet type on Baccarat, mine count on Mines, ball count on Plinko). Roulette and Slots already had this; every other single-round game in the casino now matches. Never auto-plays the round — you still tap Deal/Spin/Start/Drop yourself.
Not added to Craps — its bets (Pass Line, Come, Place, Hardways) can stay live across many rolls simultaneously with no clean single-round boundary to repeat, unlike every other game here.
